definition: how much of the drill has reached live conversation, and what has not

settled:
I catch myself using patterns with Jen that I practised in the text sessions, so the transfer is real rather than theoretical.

What has crossed so far is the conceptual side: disagreements about ideas, models and plans.

The practice is deliberately scoped there for now. I cannot afford emotional-conflict conversations yet, even with a model as the partner and even in the reduced rig.

Emotional conflict is queued rather than dropped. I expect to need it, and the cost of running it is still too high to take on.

title: What Has Crossed Over So Far
